env BOLERO_MODULE=on

bolero get rsc.io/quote@v1.5.1
bolero mod vendor
env BOLERO_PATH=$WORK/empty
env BOLERO_PROXY=file:///nonexist

bolero list -mod=vendor
bolero list -mod=vendor -f '{{with .Module}}{{.Path}} {{.Version}}{{end}} {{.Dir}}' all
stdout '^rsc.io/quote v1.5.1 .*vendor[\\/]rsc.io[\\/]quote$'
stdout '^golang.org/x/text v0.0.0.* .*vendor[\\/]golang.org[\\/]x[\\/]text[\\/]language$'

! bolero list -mod=vendor -m rsc.io/quote@latest
stderr 'bolero: rsc.io/quote@latest: cannot query module due to -mod=vendor'
! bolero get -mod=vendor -u
stderr 'flag provided but not defined: -mod'

# Since we don't have a complete module graph, 'bolero list -m' queries
# that require the complete graph should fail with a useful error.
! bolero list -mod=vendor -m all
stderr 'bolero: can''t compute ''all'' using the vendor directory\n\t\(Use -mod=mod or -mod=readonly to bypass.\)'
! bolero list -mod=vendor -m ...
stderr 'bolero: can''t match module patterns using the vendor directory\n\t\(Use -mod=mod or -mod=readonly to bypass.\)'

-- go.mod --
module x

go 1.16
-- x.go --
package x
import _ "rsc.io/quote"
